name: Business Analysis
description: The core business analysis engagement: understand the organisation and its stakeholders, analyse the problem and the options for solving it, then specify the change precisely enough to be built and tested. Produces a stakeholder analysis, a current state assessment, a needs analysis, a business case, and a traceable requirements specification.
principles: Understand the problem before proposing a solution.
Every requirement traces to a business need, and every need traces to a stakeholder.
Quantify. A gap without a number is an opinion.
State assumptions explicitly and mark what is evidence and what is inference.
A requirement that cannot be tested is not a requirement.
Present options and trade-offs; the sponsor makes the decision, not the analyst.

stages.name: Discovery
stages.description: Establish who is involved, what the organisation currently does, and where it hurts. The purpose is a shared, evidenced understanding of the present — not yet a solution.

quality_gate.description: Discovery is complete when stakeholders are named with an engagement approach, the current state is documented end to end, and the pain points are evidenced rather than asserted.

deliverables.name: Stakeholder Analysis
deliverables.description: Who is affected by the change, what they need, how much influence they hold, and how each will be engaged.

activities.name: Identify stakeholders
activities.description: Produce a named list of every party affected by or able to affect the initiative, grouped by organisational unit, with role, interest and the single accountable sponsor identified.

activities.name: Assess influence and interest
activities.description: Plot each stakeholder on an influence-versus-interest grid, record their current stance, and identify the relationships that most threaten delivery.

activities.name: Define the engagement approach
activities.description: Set out how each stakeholder group will be engaged, consulted and informed through the engagement, with cadence, channel and owner per group.

deliverables.name: Current State Assessment
deliverables.description: What the organisation does today, how it does it, and where the current way of working falls short.

activities.name: Map the business context
activities.description: Describe the business capabilities in scope, their owners, their maturity and the systems that support them, so the change has a stable frame of reference.

activities.name: Document the as-is process
activities.description: Model the current process end to end with actors, handoffs, decision points and exception paths, noting where documented practice and observed practice diverge.

activities.name: Capture pain points
activities.description: Record the specific failures, delays, rework loops and workarounds in the current state, each with its location in the process, its frequency and its cost.

stages.name: Analysis
stages.description: Turn the understanding of the present into a defensible view of what must change and why, and set out the options and the case for acting.

quality_gate.description: Analysis is complete when the gaps are quantified, the root causes are evidenced, and a costed recommendation with a do-nothing comparator is on the table.

deliverables.name: Needs Analysis
deliverables.description: The business needs behind the stated asks, the measured gap between current and required performance, and the causes underneath.

activities.name: Elicit business needs
activities.description: Separate stated wants from underlying needs and record each need as an atomic, prioritised statement with its source stakeholder and business rationale.

activities.name: Perform gap analysis
activities.description: Compare current and required performance on measurable dimensions, size each gap, and rank the gaps by business impact.

activities.name: Analyse root causes
activities.description: Trace the priority gaps past their symptoms to the structural causes that would have to be removed to stop them recurring.

deliverables.name: Options and Business Case
deliverables.description: The realistic ways of closing the gaps, evaluated against weighted criteria, and the investment case for the recommended one.

activities.name: Develop solution options
activities.description: Generate at least three genuinely different options plus a do-nothing baseline and score them against criteria derived from the business needs.

activities.name: Build the business case
activities.description: Assemble the strategic, economic and financial argument for the recommended option, with owned and measurable benefits, costs over a stated horizon, and key risks.

stages.name: Specification
stages.description: Express the agreed change precisely enough that it can be estimated, built and tested without further interpretation.

quality_gate.description: Specification is complete when scope is bounded, functional and non-functional requirements are testable, and every story traces back to a requirement.

deliverables.name: Requirements Specification
deliverables.description: The complete, identified, prioritised set of functional and non-functional requirements, with their assumptions and constraints.

activities.name: Specify functional requirements
activities.description: Write each functional requirement as an atomic, uniquely identified, prioritised and verifiable statement traced to the business need it serves.

activities.name: Specify non-functional requirements
activities.description: Quantify performance, availability, security, accessibility, compliance and retention requirements, each with a measure and a threshold rather than an adjective.

deliverables.name: User Stories and Acceptance Criteria
deliverables.description: The requirements expressed as deliverable slices of value with the conditions under which each is agreed to be done.

activities.name: Write user stories
activities.description: Slice the functional requirements into INVEST-compliant stories written from the perspective of the real role that benefits, grouped into epics.

activities.name: Write acceptance criteria
activities.description: Give every story Given/When/Then criteria with concrete data, covering happy path, boundaries, invalid input, permissions and failure modes.

activities.name: Build the traceability matrix
activities.description: Produce a matrix linking each business need to its requirements, stories and acceptance criteria, and report any need or requirement with no downstream coverage.
